missions.Title: 1. LEO Weather CubeSat
missions.Brief: Place a weather satellite in a 400 km Earth orbit, collect 100 science points, and complete 4 orbits. Add a rule to save power during eclipse.

missions.Title: 2. Lunar Mapper
missions.Brief: Map lunar craters using synthetic aperture radar. Eclipse covers 45% of each orbit, and the transmitter may overheat on orbit 2.

missions.Title: 3. Mars Probe
missions.Brief: Use a spectrometer to study the composition of the Martian atmosphere. Solar flux is only 43% of Earth's, a coronal mass ejection is expected on orbit 3, and the signal delay is 10 seconds.
